# Latency results (generated by tools/bench_latency.py)

Hardware: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-14400F; GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060, 8188 MiB, 591.86; Windows-10-10.0.26300-SP0; Python 3.11.9; onnxruntime-gpu 1.30.0 (CUDA 13 pip wheels). Probe: one real 899x1599 JPEG with one face; gallery = seeded POC001.

| Mode | n | model-service round trip p50 / p95 (ms) | detect p50 / p95 | embed p50 / p95 | end-to-end decision (client) p50 / p95 | gallery unwrap+decrypt+search p50 / p95 (gallery size) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cuda | 200 | 23.6 / 24.6 | 12.1 / 12.7 | 4.5 / 4.8 | 50.9 / 55.7 | 2.56 / 5.7 (49) |
| cpu | 200 | 363.3 / 457.9 | 142.8 / 195.8 | 207.0 / 292.6 | 456.6 / 565.4 | 26.74 / 45.61 (49) |
| cpu4 | 200 | 158.4 / 173.9 | 75.5 / 88.9 | 74.8 / 82.3 | 177.1 / 192.7 | 2.16 / 2.56 (49) |

End-to-end = gate_sim-style multipart POST to the gate-service: embed + gallery search + mock-idp 1:1 confirm (local mock, no network latency) + DB write of the gate event. Measured on one desktop; not a performance claim. cpu4 caps ONNX Runtime intra-op threads at 4 by building the sessions directly, because InsightFace get_model ignores sess_options (InsightFace issue #2899).
